key_insight: The paper builds a machine-checked Lean 4 framework that certifies key quantum neural network design tradeoffs between expressivity and trainability using formal theorems rather than informal derivations.
engineering_relevance: This gives quantum ML engineers a verified basis for designing QNN architectures and diagnosing when circuit structure, overparameterization, or symmetry assumptions support trainability and expressivity.
method: Formalized QNN theory in Lean 4 with proof-kernel checking.
Proved exact single-qubit QNN characterizations, a quantum phase processing theorem, and an overparameterization ceiling via DLA dimension.
Derived trainability results through a de-circularized second-moment interface and Casimir-based uniqueness engines for several circuit families.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a connected Lean 4 development with eight corrections and clarifications identified during formal verification.
watch_item: The strongest results depend on named hypotheses or family-specific assumptions, so practical use will require checking whether a target QNN satisfies the formal conditions.
paper_title: An Agentic Formalization for Certified Quantum Neural Network Design
